visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark, styled hair stands in a studio setting, wearing a black pleated jacket over a grey t-shirt. He gestures with his hands while looking directly at the camera. The background is dimly lit with blurred studio equipment. Yellow text overlays appear prominently at his chest level. (2) A close-up shot of a smartphone screen displays a humidity reading of 84%, followed by a scenic view of rain droplets sliding down a glass window. The man is shown in a small inset at the bottom, pointing upwards towards the humidity graphic. (3) A hand holds a small white digital thermometer showing 19.6°C and 40% humidity. The scene cuts to a wide, cinematic shot of a mountain range covered in heavy grey fog and mist. The man remains in the foreground, continuing his explanation with clear hand motions. (4) An orange sponge soaked in soapy water is squeezed by a hand, creating white foam. A woman with wet-looking hair and a blue shirt appears, wiping sweat from her forehead with a distressed expression in a brightly lit indoor room. (5) A wide shot of the Taipei skyline features the Taipei 101 tower under an overcast sky. A man inside a car is shown fanning himself frantically. The main character is then shown in a stylized black-and-white filter with animated water droplets falling across the screen. (6) A large beige LG PuriCare dehumidifier is shown in a minimalist modern living room. The man points to the device as yellow text highlights its features. A hand is shown operating the LG ThinQ app on a smartphone to control the machine remotely. (7) The man demonstrates the physical features of the dehumidifier, including the transparent water tank and the wheels at the base. He moves the device across a light-colored floor in a showroom environment with shelves and certificates in the background. He ends with a call to action, pointing down.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: 潮濕度. [Subtitle]: 大家都知道. (2) [Variety]: 潮濕度 怎麼算出來的. [Subtitle]: 但這個. (3) [Subtitle]: 如果天氣預報寫「濕度 84%」代表空氣裡有 8 成是水嗎?. (4) [Subtitle]: 當然不是, 這個「潮濕度」叫「相對濕度」. (5) [Subtitle]: 是拿當下氣溫最多能容納的水氣量跟現在空氣中的水氣量相比算出的比例. (6) [Subtitle]: 你可以把空氣想像成一塊海綿, 氣溫越高這塊海綿就越大, 能夠吸收的水氣也越多. (7) [Subtitle]: 但如果水氣太多, 海綿快吸飽了, 空氣就會開始變得悶悶濕濕的. (8) [Subtitle]: 這時候我們流的汗也更難蒸發, 所以才會整個人都覺得身體黏黏的不舒服. (9) [Subtitle]: 像台北全年平均相對濕度大概超過了 70%. [Variety]: 超過 70%. (10) [Subtitle]: 所以夏天時大家才會覺得又濕又黏又熱, 受不了你啊台北. (11) [Subtitle]: 但控制不了天氣, 我們可以控制家裡的環境. (18) [Variety]: 智慧控制除濕機. (19) [Variety]: 遠端遙控, 預約定時, 滿水提醒. (20) [Variety]: 易拉提水箱. (21) [Variety]: 萬象滾輪 搭配把手. (22) [Subtitle]: 想了解更多資訊, 馬上點擊資訊欄連結看看吧. [Slogan]: ↓ 點擊資訊欄看更多 ↓
